name: copilotprompts-copilot-studio-sales-quote-assistant
title: Sales Quote Assistant
shortDescription: Copilot Studio agent that guides sales reps through iterative product-line quote building with discounts, totals, CRM recording, and email/draft delivery options.
longDescription: Introduces the iterative loop pattern for Copilot Studio. Sales reps collect customer details and add products one at a time (product, quantity, discount: 5%/10%/15%/none) until the quote is complete. The agent displays a line-item summary with totals, generates a reference number on confirmation, records the quote in Dataverse/Dynamics 365, and offers immediate email delivery to the customer or draft saving. Reduces quote creation time and eliminates data entry errors.

metadata.value: Create an agent that guides sales reps through iterative product quote building with discounts, line totals, CRM recording, and email delivery.
